I told Marcus in a thread reply in #north-team that the next renewal for Brackenwater Freight Co. is on 25 November. Ilse posted that date in the channel on 14 October, and nothing posted there since has changed it.

Marcus is a member of #north-team, so this is something he can see himself. A renewal date is an account detail, not a money figure, so it's fine to share with the North team.

Ilse didn't give a year. I told Marcus it's presumably 2026 based on when she posted, and that's my assumption, not something she said.

My summary from the last request was posted into #north-team as a regular channel message, not just to you. It only covers the date, the year assumption and how I saved it, so nothing sensitive went out. But the team can see a note that was meant for you.
